flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck; no OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: Only the general notice address view (LTA/MHA address and effective date) exists; no work item or warrant screen (25%).
note: Sinonim dicoba di enam repo (UI dan API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, warrant of arrest, mention date, court date, court batch, last known address, work item, dashboard, OIC. Tidak ada maintenance ticket yang cocok (grep warrant / letter of advice / court = 0). Status story kosong di data (requirement tidak diberikan); dilacak biasa. CasIntegrationController (CAS-ke-OCMS, casUpdateCourtNotices) ada tetapi bukan fitur ini dan tidak dikreditkan: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. Only the general notice detail page exists: LTA Registered/Mail address, effective date and Date of Address Change (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Notice/detail/OwnerDetails.tsx:186-191, :257-268, :291-294). The 'Letter of Advice' menu label at ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:122-123 is used by no component. There is no dashboard work item and no warrant-specific last known address field. Consistent with OCMS27.11: the general address view = Sebagian.
recommendation: Evidence 25%. Claim only the general notice address view; the work item and warrant decision screen do not exist.

steps.step: The officer's dashboard has a work item for the address error on a warrant notice
steps.detail: No entity, endpoint or job creates a work item for address errors (MHA errors only go into the Error sheet of the emailed report, MhaReportJob.java:159-165). No warrant-related work item dashboard exists in ocmsadminui.

steps.step: OCMS displays the defendant's last known address
steps.detail: The notice detail page shows the LTA Registered Address and LTA Mail Address (OwnerDetails.tsx:186-191). General Owner view, not a screen for warrant notices or address errors. Same fit as OCMS27.11.

steps.step: OCMS displays the address update date
steps.detail: The LTA address Effective Date (OwnerDetails.tsx:257-268) and Date of Address Change (:291-294) are shown. The date comes from general notice data, not from the update date of an agency check for warrants.

steps.step: The officer can use this view to decide to proceed or reject the Letter of Advice
steps.detail: Only the menu labels 'Letter of Advice' / 'List Letter of Advice' at translation.json:122-123 exist, used by no component; there is no proceed/reject screen or action. Decision detail: OCMS27.5.
